purpose: Independent official Retail English rules/stats snapshots checked against cyberpunktcg.com; not evidence for unchecked printings

entries.name: Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) {Play} Defeat a rival Unit.

entries.name: Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Call} Choose one effect. Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. // Draw 1. {Spend}: Increase a Gig by up to 2.

entries.name: Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade
entries.officialRulesEnglish: 2 €$, {Spend} A friendly Unit can attack spent rival Units the turn it's played. If it's a ROCKER Unit, also give it +2 power this turn. This effect costs -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value.

entries.name: Royce: Psycho on the Edge
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.) During your turn, this Legend has +2 power for each of its equipped Gear.

entries.name: V: Streetkid
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand. {Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)

entries.name: 6th Street Recruits
entries.officialRulesEnglish: When a friendly Unit steals a d6, increase a Gig by up to 6.

entries.name: Animals Wrecker
entries.officialRulesEnglish: [Flavour Text] Takes a lot of juice to break bones like they do.

entries.name: Chrome Fang
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Play} Until your next turn, rival Units can't steal friendly Gigs with value higher than their power.

entries.name: El Sombrerón: La Venganza Lenta
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Attack} You may pay 2 €$. If you do, this Unit gains power equal to a friendly max Gig this turn.

entries.name: Japantown Jonin
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Play} Give a friendly Unit +2 power this turn. (Units with power 0 don't steal Gigs.)

entries.name: Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting
entries.officialRulesEnglish: The first time this Unit wins a fight each turn, ready it. This Unit wins all fights against CORPO Units.

entries.name: Kerry Eurodyne: The Last Rockerboy
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Spend} If you control a Gig with 8+ value, draw 2.

entries.name: La Llorona: Ghost of the Past
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Blocker} (You may spend this Unit to redirect a rival Unit's attack to it instead.) When this Unit uses {Blocker}, increase a Gig by up to 3.

entries.name: Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Blocker} This Unit has +2 power while fighting a Legend. When a Rival adjusts or swaps 1 or more friendly Gigs, you may add a card from your trash to your hand.

entries.name: Octant
entries.officialRulesEnglish: Play this Unit for -1 €$ for each friendly Gig with 8+ value, to a minimum of 1 €$.

entries.name: Royce: Don't Call Me Simon
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Play} Defeat a rival Unit with power 2 or less. If you have more ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, defeat a rival Unit with power 3 or less instead.

entries.name: Ruthless Lowlife
entries.officialRulesEnglish: This Unit can only attack rival Units. (It can't attack Gig areas.)

entries.name: Swordwise Huscle
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Attack} If this Unit has power 5+, draw 1.

entries.name: V: Roamer of the Badlands
entries.officialRulesEnglish: When this Unit steals a Gig, increase it by up to 5. At the end of your turn, if you control 2 or more Gigs with 8+ value, draw 1.

entries.name: Valentino Guerrera
entries.officialRulesEnglish: If you have more ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, this Unit can attack ready Units with {Blocker}.

entries.name: Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon
entries.officialRulesEnglish: {Play} You may play a Unit with cost 4 or less from your hand or trash for free. It can attack rival Units this turn. The first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated each turn, draw 1.

entries.name: Arasaka Emergency Radioport
entries.officialRulesEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) When this Unit or Legend is spent, you may look at a friendly face-down Legend. If that Legend is ARASAKA or has {Go Solo}, you may Call it for free. (You may only Call a Legend once per turn.)

entries.name: Deadman Transmitter
entries.officialRulesEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) If this Unit would be defeated, defeat its "DEADMAN TRANSMITTER" instead.

entries.name: Mantis Blades
entries.officialRulesEnglish: (Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.) "One cut, one kill."

entries.name: Towerfall
entries.officialRulesEnglish: Choose one effect. If you have less ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, choose both instead. Give all rival Units -5 power this turn. // Bottom-deck all rival Units with power 0.
entries.note: Effect and stats match; artist credit is corrected to Dardo Studios by Oct 28 errata, despite old text on the card detail page.
